timing_verdict.label: NEUTRAL
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: NEUTRAL timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,410 KRW per USD

WHY: The won has strengthened significantly—the exchange rate has fallen 130-141 won in the past month, making dollars cheaper to buy. However, multiple sources indicate the market is stabilizing and may hover around current levels, with potential central bank and trilateral (Korea-US-Japan) intervention limiting further sharp moves.

TIP: Since you need $2,000 monthly regardless, consider setting a standing order at your current rate rather than trying to time a strengthening won—this removes emotion and locks in predictable costs.
